title: DSE · Data completeness
description: What is actually in the warehouse: which instruments, how many days, which attributes, and where the holes are.

panels.title: Instruments ever seen
panels.description: Every trading code that has appeared at any point in the window.

panels.title: Listed on the newest day
panels.description: The gap to 'ever seen' is delistings — mostly bonds reaching maturity.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) from marts.dim_instrument where last_seen_on = (select max(trade_date) from marts.fact_daily_price)

panels.title: Completeness
panels.description: Days actually held, against the trading days inside each instrument's own first-seen to last-seen span. Not a share of a rectangle: instruments legitimately arrive and leave.

targets.rawSql:
with cal as (select distinct trade_date from marts.fact_daily_price), per as (
  select i.trading_code, min(f.trade_date) as f, max(f.trade_date) as l,
         count(*) as present,
         sum(case when f.did_not_trade then 1 else 0 end) as dnt
  from marts.fact_daily_price f
  join marts.dim_instrument i using (instrument_key)
  group by i.trading_code
)
select round(100.0*sum(present)/nullif(sum((select count(*) from cal c where c.trade_date between per.f and per.l)),0), 2)::float8 as completeness
from per

panels.title: Coverage
panels.description: The exchange serves a rolling two-year window; nothing older is obtainable.

targets.rawSql: select min(trade_date) as "first day", max(trade_date) as "last day", count(distinct trade_date) as "days" from marts.fact_daily_price

panels.title: Instrument catalogue
panels.description: Every instrument, least complete first. 'Did not trade %' near 100 marks an instrument that is listed and priced but effectively never trades — treasury bonds, mostly.

targets.rawSql:
with cal as (select distinct trade_date from marts.fact_daily_price), per as (
  select i.trading_code, min(f.trade_date) as f, max(f.trade_date) as l,
         count(*) as present,
         sum(case when f.did_not_trade then 1 else 0 end) as dnt
  from marts.fact_daily_price f
  join marts.dim_instrument i using (instrument_key)
  group by i.trading_code
)
select per.trading_code as "code",
       per.f as "first seen",
       per.l as "last seen",
       per.present as "days held",
       (select count(*) from cal c where c.trade_date between per.f and per.l) as "days expected",
       round(100.0*per.present/nullif((select count(*) from cal c where c.trade_date between per.f and per.l),0),1) as "complete %",
       round(100.0*per.dnt/nullif(per.present,0),1) as "did not trade %"
from per
order by "complete %" asc, per.trading_code

panels.title: Attributes
panels.description: The four trade prices are missing on exactly the days an instrument did not trade — 123,520 rows, 39.5%, and verified to be precisely the non-traded set: no traded row is missing a price, and no non-traded row carries one. On those same rows volume, turnover and trade count are not missing, they are zero, which is why their `populated` count is the full 312,759. Compare the `zeros` column against `missing` and the two halves line up. The exchange publishes it this way: a non-traded instrument arrives with open, high, low and last-traded zeroed and a close still quoted. One asymmetry is real: turnover has 215 more zeros than volume, because the exchange publishes it in millions to three decimals. A day worth under about 500 taka rounds to 0.000 — the largest such row implies 500 taka against 310 shares. Kept as zero rather than nulled, since zero is within 500 taka of the truth and a null would lose more than it saves.

targets.rawSql:
select 'open_price' as "attribute",
       count(open_price) as "populated",
       count(*) filter (where open_price = 0) as "zeros",
       count(*) - count(open_price) as "missing",
       round(100.0*(count(*)-count(open_price))/count(*),1) as "missing %",
       min(open_price)::text as "min", max(open_price)::text as "max"
from marts.fact_daily_price
union all
select 'high_price' as "attribute",
       count(high_price) as "populated",
       count(*) filter (where high_price = 0) as "zeros",
       count(*) - count(high_price) as "missing",
       round(100.0*(count(*)-count(high_price))/count(*),1) as "missing %",
       min(high_price)::text as "min", max(high_price)::text as "max"
from marts.fact_daily_price
union all

from marts.fact_daily_price

       min(last_traded_price)::text as "min", max(last_traded_price)::text as "max"
from marts.fact_daily_price
union all
select 'close_price' as "attribute",
       count(close_price) as "populated",
       count(*) filter (where close_price = 0) as "zeros",
       count(*) - count(close_price) as "missing",
       round(100.0*(count(*)-count(close_price))/count(*),1) as "missing %",
       min(close_price)::text as "min", max(close_price)::text as "max"
from marts.fact_daily_price
union all
select 'previous_close' as "attribute",
       count(previous_close) as "populated",
       count(*) filter (where previous_close = 0) as "zeros",
       count(*) - count(previous_close) as "missing",
       round(100.0*(count(*)-count(previous_close))/count(*),1) as "missing %",
       min(previous_close)::text as "min", max(previous_close)::text as "max"
from marts.fact_daily_price
union all
select 'volume' as "attribute",
       count(volume) as "populated",
       count(*) filter (where volume = 0) as "zeros",
       count(*) - count(volume) as "missing",
       round(100.0*(count(*)-count(volume))/count(*),1) as "missing %",
       min(volume)::text as "min", max(volume)::text as "max"
from marts.fact_daily_price
union all
select 'turnover' as "attribute",
       count(turnover) as "populated",
       count(*) filter (where turnover = 0) as "zeros",
       count(*) - count(turnover) as "missing",

       min(turnover)::text as "min", max(turnover)::text as "max"
from marts.fact_daily_price
union all
select 'trade_count' as "attribute",
       count(trade_count) as "populated",
       count(*) filter (where trade_count = 0) as "zeros",
       count(*) - count(trade_count) as "missing",
       round(100.0*(count(*)-count(trade_count))/count(*),1) as "missing %",
       min(trade_count)::text as "min", max(trade_count)::text as "max"
from marts.fact_daily_price
order by "missing" desc, "attribute"

panels.title: Rows per trading day
panels.description: One point per trading day. A missing point is a day the warehouse does not hold; a dip is a day the exchange published fewer instruments.

targets.rawSql: select trade_date as time, count(*) as instruments from marts.fact_daily_price group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Traded vs did not trade
panels.description: The split has been remarkably stable near 39% not trading.

targets.rawSql:
select trade_date as time,
       count(*) filter (where not did_not_trade) as traded,
       count(*) filter (where did_not_trade) as "did not trade"
from marts.fact_daily_price group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Instruments with gaps
panels.description: Instruments absent on days the exchange was open and they were otherwise listed. An empty table is the healthy state.

targets.rawSql:
with cal as (select distinct trade_date from marts.fact_daily_price), per as (
  select i.trading_code, min(f.trade_date) as f, max(f.trade_date) as l,
         count(*) as present,
         sum(case when f.did_not_trade then 1 else 0 end) as dnt
  from marts.fact_daily_price f
  join marts.dim_instrument i using (instrument_key)
  group by i.trading_code
)
select per.trading_code as "code", per.f as "first seen", per.l as "last seen",
       (select count(*) from cal c where c.trade_date between per.f and per.l) - per.present as "days missing",
       per.present as "days held"
from per
where (select count(*) from cal c where c.trade_date between per.f and per.l) > per.present
order by "days missing" desc
